items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Yeah, but Carmen was a good player. I was familiar with what he did.

ctx.x: Yeah, but Carmen was a good player. I was familiar with what he did. That band was a lot of fun. You know it was a very loose band, and people used to accuse it of being loud

and out of tune, but it really wasn’t. It had moments when it probably was, but most of the time it was a pretty sensitive band, and the guys all got along most of the time. But it was something that I’m glad I did. I don’t know if I’d want to — well I know I wouldn’t want to repeat it at my age now, but it was something that I’m glad I did.
